name: RAN Training Procedure
definition: An unsupervised training procedure using a Reconstruction Adversarial Network (RAN) and pix2pix networks to find an internal representation that minimizes content-wise changes while translating between image spaces.
summary: RAN Training is an unsupervised method for reconstructing 3D geometry from 2D images using adversarial learning and cycle-consistency, distinguishing itself from physical scattering models.
